title: BT launches Cyber Prepared UK, a cyber resilience training programme for small businesses
date_note: BT's release is dated 26 November 2026; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: BT announced Cyber Prepared UK, a nationwide programme of cyber-attack simulations for small businesses, with in-person sessions from early 2027 and online options. BT says it aims for 100,000 hours of cyber resilience training by the end of 2028. The release cites a more than 500% increase in malicious cyber scans over the last year and names the National Cyber Security Centre among its backers.
plain: BT is launching a training programme where small businesses practise handling simulated cyber-attacks, with sessions starting in early 2027.
exec: BT says it aims for 100,000 hours of cyber resilience training by the end of 2028, aimed at small businesses.

sources.name: BT (PR Newswire): BT launches nationwide cyber resilience drive as AI helps fuel 500% surge in malicious activity

evidence.quote: more than 500% increase in malicious cyber scans

validation.note: Single source: BT's release via PR Newswire; the Scotsman and other outlets carry the same story but were not read.
